reviews.comment: BEST professor I have had at A&M. He teaches concepts very well, but would still HIGHLY encourage to use the textbook. Do not assume that don't panic having no homework means no time should be spent outside of class studying for this class. Tests are a huge portion of your grade, but the common exams help. Attend SI if needed.

He's the best physics prof I've had. He taught everything super well and was easy to follow. He makes a hard class manageable and id definitely take him again. Don't listen to the other reviews it's just full of people who got mad they couldn't get a good grade without putting in any work. As long as you try and study the material you'll be fine

THE GOAT for PHYS 207. Very good at explaining concepts, and happy to answer questions. Of course, with this being Dont Panic, you will have to read the book. I guarantee most of the people struggling did not use the book. The exams were typically harder than the public common exams, but if you know what you are doing they were fair.

This is supposed to be a hard class but Kordell just makes it harder imo. The material is challenging, but the way kordell explains things is way more complicated than it needs to be. Waffles a lot and doesn't help understanding at all. All of my learning is outside of lecture so being in lecture is such a waste of time but it's mandatory

Kind man, just a bad teacher. Often overcomplicates problems and he lectures more like he's rambling to himself. Exams are always way different than the ones from previous years and are graded harshly. Expects you to understand what he's talking about as he's going but doesn't answer questions all that well.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures were very hard to engage with if you came from a simpler physics 206 background at another school. He teaches at a very abstract, hard-to-follow level, and most learning will be done from the textbook. Grades like you owe him money at times, with no curve. He does care a lot about your success, but he just is not a great teacher.
THE goat for phys 6 & 7

The course concepts in hindsight weren't that bad, but the tests are graded very harshly. Yes, partial credit, but there are little details that will lose all chance of credit even if the rest is right. Lectures weren't that helpful if you don't understand what's happening. Do all practice exams and not the weird gradescope homework to prepare.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Okay, so this class was kind of a rollercoaster in terms of the grading. Some of the midterms were absolute hell (~50% averages), but then the final was probably the easiest one in years.

In terms of actual teaching, I thought he was alright. He's willing to sit with you and work through problems if really needed, and I felt like he did care.
He waffles a lot and expects you to know things that he does not explain, really smart guy thought very strict on grading.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Next time you are in a dream, hope to not wake up, because walking into one of Kordell's lectures is the true nightmare. Exams and final weigh 85% of the class and are extremely difficult. Lectures are hard to follow. By finals on December 16th, 2025, 70% of the class has dropped. Average scores on the 3 midterms are 60%, 54%, and 49%. No curve.

Oh Michael where do i begin, the way you skip algebra steps during lecture makes my heart skip a beat. Having to go to lecture for iclicker but getting nothing out of it made my day. (mid prof don't take him if you can but final was pretty easy and was out of 110 secured my A)
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took a long time to respond to emails. PHYS 207 as a class is designed to make students fail. Kordell is an ok professor, but you would be better off watching the recitation videos and the overviews than paying attention in lecture. Use the solved problems as review once you have already learned the material.

The worst professor, I asked a question for a clear explain, he answered me: It is what it is.That is bs. His exam was not related to the course content. The difficulty of the exam is much more difficult than practice. Be aware that there are many professors who teach Physics 206, which is a difficult course, but why did he have the lowest score?

This class is so hard man. After doing every practice problem and exercise in the book, I'm still getting the median score of around 60 for each exam. Only take Kordell if you already have mechanics experience or can self-study very well. He is kind, intelligent, and passionate about physics, but nothing he explains sticks in my brain.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Kordell isn't really a bad teacher, but the course if horrific, Don't panic is a very horrible class. The rubric is also not specific as it changes between years.  This class is just university level 206 but a lot harder. I don't recommend nor advise anyone take this course. Teacher isn't bad but lectures can only go so far for conceptual stuff
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'm in his class right now, he is probably one of the worst professors I have ever had. I usually try and not bash someone online but he is an exception. His lectures are completely useless. He talks to himself most of the time and just expects you to get it. Not a single one of the exam averages was above a 60 with the lowest one being under 50.

Kordell is good. 

Grade is mostly exams but gives a lot of previous exams to study. He responds quickly to questions and office hours can be helpful. 

It's a hard class but not too bad. I also like that he gives the exams back/does regrade requests online so I can see how my stuff was graded.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kordell is a great professor. Yes the class is hard but it's supposed to be. Very entertaining in lecture, does not assign graded homework, and he is generous with partial credit on exams. The class is 85% exam so be sure to study for the exam

In his class rn. If I had to describe it in a few words: I walk to class hoping a bus runs me over. Don't expect to get anything helpful out of lecture. Ever. Don't expect him to answer questions well. Ever. Prepare to self-teach EVERYTHING. Seriously. Self-teaching every concept is genuinely way more productive than even trying to understand him.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Please save yourself. Nice guy but just can't teach. Plain and simple. Overcomplicates everything. Can't explain anything. Rushes through lectures and just expects you to know how he's getting from question to answer without explaining why/how. I'm serious. This guy does math in his head during lecture and expects you to know what he did.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The worst and hardest class I have taken at A&M. Dr. Kordell did not teach anything in his class, but would go on about how if this was calculus based we would do it a certain way. Practice tests did not help neither did lab. DO NOT TAKE HIM
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It's his first time teaching 201as opposed to the normal calculus based physics 206. His lectures are often overcomplicated and leave me grasping at straws. His demonstrations are cool and recitations are helpful. Most of the time I had to self teach but he does post lots of previous exams that are helpful in getting high grades.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is the bane of my existence. I usually do not struggle in science classes, but Kordell cannot teach, its that simple. The lectures are so hard to follow and he doesn't explain anything, just expects you to know. I took this over the summer thinking it would be easy, its not. Save yourself the Q-drop and take it at a community college.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: After having him for both phys 206 and 207, I can say I know how to teach myself class material. If you take him be ready to learn all of the material outside of class. None of his lectures are engaging or helpful for students. If you can DO NOT TAKE HIM
E&M was very easy with Professor Kordell. This class changed my life and I realized what an amazing professor Kordell is. I ultimately recommend, you will have a great time in this class! :))

Take 207 anywhere else (community college) if easily available. However, it's not the end of the world if you take it here. Show up to class every day (it was the difference between an A and B for me). PRACTICE THE POSTED OLD EXAMS. Honestly, I didn't learn much from his lectures, so imo it doesn't matter who you take don't panic 207 with.

Kordell is a great guy, but his lectures are overcomplicated and not very helpful. Still attend lecture for a free iClicker grade. A B is very manageable by just watching the supplementary/recitation videos before class/recitation and taking a bunch of old exams. Recitation quizzes aren't bad and comprehensive final can replace lowest midterm exam.

Professor Kordell's  lectures are often unengaging and include material not reflected on exams. To succeed, supplemental instruction is strongly recommended. Be careful though, he frequently deducts points if problems aren't solved using his exact, overcomplicated, method. If possible, take literally anyone else because he is the WORST for 207.

He's genuinely a really nice guy and will go above and beyond for you. As for lecture, most people feel he overcomplicates methods, but iClickers are free 100s and rec quizzes aren't bad. The majority of your learning will be through recitation/rec videos. His midterm grading is a bit harsh, but the final had 10 bonus points so lock in.
He is evil and can't explain the content properly :(
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Kordell is very kind and offers useful office hours. Phys 206 essentially comprises of just practicing the same problems over and over again, and Kordell likes to emphasize practice in office hours. The exams essentially are either you know it or not. By sheer repetition, you should be fine in 206. Lectures are not helpful but useful for practice.

Physics is a hard course but he is probably one of the best profs for the class. Explains things pretty well but it is very easy to fall behind. Make sure you do all the recitation homework and tons of practice tests.
He's great.

Kordell was nice but his lectures were sometimes counterproductive. Attendance is taken with IClicker but very much needed as the class is very lecture heavy. No homework and grades come from recitation quizzes and tests alone. Tests are HARD. Felt like Kordell could of done a little bit more in terms of explaining concepts.

Caring professor. PHYS 206 is hard no matter who you get- Kordell makes sure to emphasize how you will learn the material: through problem solving. Most of your learning and review for exams will be done at recitation and by taking common exams. Lectures can be boring to sit through-try to pay enough attention for the iClicker quiz at the end.

Physics 206 is hard, regardless of which professor you get. Kordell is a charismatic professor and explains things thoroughly. There's no assigned homework, so you get what you put into the class. Also, attendance is mandatory with iClicker, so don't take the 8am section.
Dr. Kordell is great so f
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good lecturer that cares about his students. Is easy to understand and has good handwriting, unlike other profs as I've heard. Takes attendance via a one-question quiz each class which counts for a small portion of the overall grade. He's very open about what could be on exams and is very accessible for questions. Highly recommend him.

Dr. Kordell was a pretty decent professor. His lectures were difficult to comprehend at times, as he overcomplicated most things, but overall ok. He is extremely nice, and tries his best. The exams are common, but there are many resources online to prepare with. Kordell is a pretty good physics professor if you cannot get Nodurft.

Kordell is a great person, he tried his best to make lectures engaging and teach in depth. However, he overcomplicates methods which in turn resulted in poor test grades. He's great one on one but definitely use supplemental materials to fully understand. He does care, he is willing to help and he has great character.

I want to preface this by saying I was at best mediocre at physics in high school. This man single handedly opened my eyes to physics. He is insanely intelligent and cares about his students. His lectures can be confusing at first, but always make sense the closer the test gets. Honestly may have been the greatest teacher I've ever had.

With Kordell you will walk away from lectures having learned nothing. Lectures are often overexplained or you'll have a "but we wont worry about that" moment. Use supplemental materials rather than your notes to study for exams. Professors can throw absolutely anything from your chapters on your exam, even if you haven't seen it before in class.
He's alright, I would take tatiana or nodurft if you can. He posts his notes which are color-coded and clear which is helpful. I wish he was a little more straight to the point in lectures.

Really nice guy who wants people to succeed, but overcomplicates problems. I was completely lost in his lectures, until a tutor explained to me clear as day in 10 minutes what he couldn't in weeks of lectures. He's passionate and smart, but I wish he would be a little bit more "to-the-point" with solutions.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This pains me to do because Kordell is a really nice guy, but he somehow manages to make a 1 hr 15 min lecture just about as useful as a 30 minute lecture. Nearly every lecture he will over-explain every single topic and finish with "but we won't worry about that in this class". Really inefficient way of teaching this material; take Dr Holt.

Kordell's lectures are quite good, but they can be somewhat confusing at times. However, the midterms are not too hard to do well on (B or up) as long as you study with the physics supplemental materials and show up for recitation. A lot of points lost in tests are due to non-conceptual mistakes such as algebra; take your time.

Kordell is mediocre, he overcomplicates the subject when certain problems can be solved one way he usually goes on lengthy tangents about the million other ways to set up the problem. He seems to care a lot about his students but he goes through material too quick.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Really great professor. My favorite thing about him is that he posts his lecture notes, which are always detailed and informative. He's a really nice guy too.

I would recommend Kordell for PHYS206, lectures are a little hard to follow at first but you can adjust to his teaching style. Tests turn out ot be easier than expected and like all other Dont Panic sections, use the supplimental material and past exams to study. Overall pretty easy and not crazy time consuming

Kordell is a mid-prof in Physics Department. Take Tatiana or Dawson if you can, but if you can't he is fine. His explanations can be overly complex, but since exams are common and the Don't Panic website is so good, you can do fine with him. His exam reviews have the exam problems almost exactly, so make sure to look at them.
Lectures were slightly difficult to follow, and had attendance count for a grade. Accessible during office hours and was willing to give points back on the exams. The final was pretty easy.

This class is pretty tough overall. Kordell is a passionate professor but your professor really doesn't matter in this course, forget the lectures and just do practice exams with recitation videos and you will be fine. He told us what problems would be on his final and his final was very similar to previous ones where as other profs. differed.

I think I am not much of a lecture person, I do a lot of my learning by doing practice questions. His lectures for me were usually not super helpful, I only attended for in-class clicker questions. Make sure to do lots of practice tests and watch Tatiana's recitation videos if you want to succeed. This isn't just him, it's really for any professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Kordell for PHYS 206 and 207, and I can say that he was a good professor. He has a clear passion for physics and wants his students to succeed. He gets very into detail in his lectures which can make them a bit boring, but other than that he was good.

Such a nice professor!! 207 terrified before actually taking it, but Kordell made it quite interesting. He's super nice and always happy to help if you have questions over the material (he even answers emails on weekends or the day before an exam). It is a hard class concept wise so make sure to put in the work and come to lecture.

Kordell was just overall a great guy. He was okay at teaching and sometimes went off-topic but was able to teach the material effectively. But I digress. Exams are important for your grade in this class.

Wasn't a bad guy, just very detailed about his work which made it a nightmare for me just trying to follow along while he was on his 20th round simplifying an equation with just letters in it. It was fine, just a tough class no matter what you do. Physics is kind of like coding where it takes a second to click, so just keep studying. It'll buff.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Kordell is willing to give points back on the tests if you come to office hours and there's room in the rubric. His biggest strength is also his weakness: he is very detail-focused. Sometimes this is good, but other times I feel like he's "missing the forest for the trees."
As a person, he's very down-to-earth and caring.

Don't Panic is a hard class, but Kordell is a good lecturer and will give good feedback and elaborate on any topics if asked. Physics website with supplemental materials and practice exams very useful for studying

Good at explaining concepts. Lecture examples are a good start but recitation quizzes and practice exams necessary to do well. This is a hard class and the majority of your grade will be exams, but missing class a lot will impact your average. Lectures not posted online if you miss class, may give points back on exams in office hours. Final is hard

His lectures are not helpful. I was carried by professor Tatiana's supplemental video lectures. His final outright destroyed my grade. The midterms were easy A's, but the final is something you can't really prepare for. Every exam also always has a "gotcha !" question. Just do university physics instead.

Kordell is a decent professor who can explain the topics well but can be messy when it comes to practice problems, sometimes making it too hard to read or making simple mistakes which could make the rest of the work done confusing. His office hours are great for 1 on 1 help, but I recommend using the physics website to help nail down topics.

He's a great professor. His lectures are thorough and even if they're confusing at times, he clears any questions up very well when asked about it. However, this is still a difficult class, so use the practice exams and other supplemental materials to get through.

Attendance was mandatory because of iClicker, which counted as a part of the grade.

Overall, Dr. Kordell was effective in teaching students physics 1. While some of lectures were confusing, he always cleared up issues in office hours. In addition, he held reviews before exams which covered all of the content. This is a hard class however and supplemental resources such as spartan tutoring are necessary to do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kordell is a pretty genuine guy who cares about the material he's teaching which is great, but for some reason he's not really interesting to follow in lecture despite how enthusiastic he is about the material. He is very helpful if you ask him questions though.

Professor Kordell was not very good at explaining the topics we were covering, and often overcomplicated them. I had already taken physics in high school, so I wasn't very confused, but I would have been if I didn't take this in high school. 90% of your grade comes from exams and this is a DP course so it is all variables and no numbers.

Professor Kordell was a great guy and cared for how his students did, but this class is not that exciting. It is all based on boring lectures and tests where to do well you have to memorize problems from the previous year's common exams. I don't think it's as bad as people say, but Professor Kordell does his best to help out.

Kordell is a reasonable choice for Don't Panic. iClicker quizzes almost every class. He teaches well but the material is incredibly difficult especially with the lack of numbers. TA's are incredibly helpful for exam prep. Provided a slight curve and a bonus question. He is pretty approachable and does his best to make the course bearable.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor! Attending office hours really helps and he will answer any questions. He provides you with all the resources you could use. Attend class and recitation for all those notes points, especially exam reviews he does to do well. He does not give hw so practicing is all on you. Overall not an impossible class and it is likely to do good!

Professor Kordell is not at the same level as Tatiana or Dawson, but he was still a very good prof. Very friendly guy and easy to access with any questions after class or through email. I relied a lot on my TA and past exams to do well but he also has good review sessions before every exam. You can definitely succeed in his course.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kordell himself is a very nice guy and he lectured with care, but unfourtunatly with the material itself his teaching wasnt that successful in making the content any more digestable or easy to understand.The common theme was essentially memorize the past exams and learn to completely replicate the process of solving the problem types. Great guy tho
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Your professor for 207 does not matter since they all use the same bad book. Unfortunately, attendance is mandatory but all you have to do is take as many practice exams in the days before the exam and can do other work in class. Kordell talks extremely slowly and is honestly very annoying. Try and take Tatiana if you care about learning.

Spent too long on conceptuals. Tests are hard, our final average was 58 before the curve. Luckily Kordell understands how hard the class is and does "final replaces lowest exam", gave 10 points of extra credit on the final and a 3-point curve overall. His lectures don't compare to Tatiana or Dawson, so make sure you do many practice exams to learn.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Phys 206 DP is a very difficult class, but Dr. Kordell makes it easier. I don't understand why people complain about this prof, I have a 99. The only reason I don't have a 100 is because I made a careless mistake on an exam. Hands down the best professor I have ever taken in the physics department. All of y'all just need to study more. Study More!

Physics 207 Don't Panic sucks, but Kordell makes it manageable. His lectures and review sessions are extremely valuable and his quizzes in lecture are easy. He gives lots of hints for what will be on the exams. If you take this prof and work out the previous exams and problems in the book you will be fine in this class.

Summer 5-Week Session. Professor Kordell was amazing! He is a fun guy, relaxed, and does a great job at taking a difficult subject and making it very simple. Very helpful. 10% of the grade came from freebee attendance assignments, and the rest came from the midterms and final. Overall, much more enjoyable than my 206 class was.

I recommend 100%. No recitation quizzes that lower your grade, only attendance is graded. Clear lectures with lots of examples. Freebie quizzes during lectures that help your grade. Answers emails quickly & completely. In-class review sessions are very helpful. Overall a great experience. Do buy & use the textbook, though!

Dr. Kordell did a pretty good job with his lectures. He explained the physics concepts well and also worked out many problems during lectures which prepared you for the tests very well. He was very happy to schedule office hours and gave good feedback. Moreover, he did test reviews where he worked out questions similar to the test.

I would like to preface by saying that this is my review of his DP 206 ONLINE class. I could easily see how Kordell would be a great professor teaching in person, but the online lectures did not live up to that. He didn't read the chat often, making asking questions difficult. This is the only B I've gotten so far which is unfortunate.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Don't Panic is a difficult course if you have not taken physics before. However, Professor Kordell is willing to answer questions and does review sessions on the weekends before tests. He uses very technical terms, so it may be difficult to understand and stay engaged during class. Use the practice exams (4 for each exam) & review sessions wisely!
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Test heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Don't Panic Version. This class only uses variables and no numbers so I found it really nice. It is very calc based so you don't have to remember too many formulae. Dr. Kordell is very understanding and puts in a ton of effort to hold review sessions for the exams. The exams can get pretty difficult but you have access to reviews and past exams.

Kordell is a good professor and can explain physics concepts well. The "Don't Panic" version of 206 is pretty difficult because there are no numbers to work with, just symbols. The only bad side of Kordell is his exam problems are typically harder than any example you will see in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: PHYS207 is a rough course no matter who you take it with, but I found Prof Kordell's class was pretty reasonable. He is very knowledgeable and gives good examples. He gives access to all the old tests (STUDY THEM). If you go in blind and just wing the tests, you'll probably fail, but if you go to recitation and study, an A/B is manageable.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Kordell was pretty meh, he seemed to make this class kind of a last priority. He showed up late for class often and his slides had errors quite a bit. The lectures weren't too helpful, I just showed up because there's a clicker Q each class. He replies to emails quickly, is happy to help students after class, and is quite friendly though.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Don't Panic version. Any time not able to make it to office hours Dr. Kordell was available through email and in person appointments. Some online homework through ecampus but most of the grade was based on the tests. We did use iclicker for attendance. If you do better on final than any of your other exams it will also replace lowest grade!

Dr. Kordell is great, the subject matter is tough no matter who you take it with, but he makes himself available to help with questions. He also will make appointments if you can't attend his normal office hours which has helped me a ton so far this semester
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.
